exposure: Prophylactic norepinephrine infusion at 0 ug/kg/min (normal saline)
outcome: Incidence of maternal hypotension (systolic blood pressure < 80% of baseline)
Deviation of systolic blood pressure control (median performance error; median absolute performance error)
Other adverse events for mother or neonate
cohort: The study included 180 preeclamptic patients aged 18-45 scheduled for cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Prophylactic infusion of norepinephrine effectively reduced the incidence of maternal hypotension in preeclamptic patients under spinal anesthesia during cesarean delivery in a dose-dependent manner, without increasing other adverse events for either the mother or neonate.
